description: Send one message body to 1 to 100 recipients on one channel: WhatsApp, SMS or email. Use it for an alert, a summary or a one-off notification where everyone gets the same text. To reach a saved contact group, put its grp_ id in to. When each recipient needs different content (a summary per branch, a notification per order) use sendkuy_send_batch. A campaign prepared in the SendKuy dashboard is started with sendkuy_start_campaign and can be paused or cancelled midway. Phone numbers must be E.164 with the leading + (for example +6281234567890). This really sends and spends SendKuy credit. A recipient on the suppression list or who unsubscribed still gets a message id and fails later; read the final status with sendkuy_get_messages. One recipient is sent while you wait; several are queued and sent in the background, paced per number. Pass dedupe_key so a retried step does not send twice. The answer counts every message per status and lists the first 20; read the rest with sendkuy_list_messages.

attachments.description: Email only, at most ten files fetched from URLs you host.

body.description: The text. HTML is allowed on email.

dedupe_key.description: A key derived from the event this call reports, such as "order-1234-shipped" or "daily-revenue-2026-10-29". Calling again with the same key and the same input returns the first answer instead of sending twice. The same key with different input is refused with idempotency_key_reused, so keep changing values such as the time out of a deduplicated message. A refusal (for example insufficient_credits or a bad number) is remembered under the key too: after fixing it, retry with a new key. Keys are remembered for about 24 hours.

gateway_id.description: Optional sender. Leave it out and SendKuy picks a live sender on the channel and moves to the next one if it fails.

media.description: WhatsApp only. One attachment, fetched from a URL you host.

schedule_at.description: Send later instead of now, as ISO 8601 with a time zone offset, for example 2026-11-01T09:00:00+07:00.

subject.description: Required on email, refused on other channels.

template_id.description: WhatsApp only. A template id from sendkuy_list_templates.

template_parameters.description: WhatsApp only. Values for the template variables.

to.description: Recipients: E.164 phone numbers (or email addresses on email), contact ids (con_...) from sendkuy_find_contacts, or group ids (grp_...) from sendkuy_list_groups. A group sends to every member.

name: sendkuy_send_message
title: Send a message
